sql.if: AND (company_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO company (company_no, name, manager, phone, established_date, remark, enabled) VALUES (#{companyNo}, #{name}, #{manager}, #{phone}, #{establishedDate}, #{remark}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE company SET company_no = #{companyNo}, name = #{name}, manager = #{manager}, phone = #{phone}, established_date = #{establishedDate}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE company SET enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
